guarantees.claim: always_comb loop assigns hw2reg.data_out[i].d = data_out_q[i] for i=0..NumRegsData-1.

uncertain_points.claim: hw2reg.data_out[i].d might be driven by other parts of the design; if multiple drivers exist, simulation/synthesis results are unpredictable.
uncertain_points.cond: if any other process assigns to the same signal.
uncertain_points.risk: Could cause X propagation or contention, corrupting AES output data read by software.

uncertain_points.claim: The combinational path unconditionally forwards data_out_q to hw2reg; if an AES error condition should zeroize or mask the output, this logic does not enforce it.
uncertain_points.cond: when an error or invalid data state occurs.
uncertain_points.risk: Secret plaintext, intermediate values, or erroneous data could be exposed to software via the CSR path.
